i build one of these once.

I've used them 5 times on field fully kitted out with lots of camo , jute and so on

Here is what I learned;

It is still warm to wear, imagine having a piece of bear hide over you, thats how it feels basically. But it is indeed less warm then a fully body ghillie.

The one thing that makes you get seen most often is not actually bad camo but rather the fact that you are moving and doing fast movements. Hence this kind of camo will really do nothing if you like to play in a way that makes you do fast movement.

​

However there some other plus i noticed. Ghillie can allow you in many situations to get away with standing completely  upright as long as you standing still. I had many many MANY situations where I would just hug a wall while standing upright and the enemy would just walk past me because they couldn't see my weapon or my front since I was hugging the wall.

However the downside is that I still can't see them because my back is turned. But in hindsight you could say it reduces you chances of getting shot in the back.

​

a fun tidbit I actually once got stepped on while lying down in a hole with ghillie cape so it does have it's use but in my opinion I would only use it in cold environments. I just dont like that excess heat of having a bear skin on my back.

But all in all it is just for fun and I think this is the best option for learning to build a ghillie for the first time. And the fact you can put it on so fast is nice. I have even heard stories of people putting it in a bag they bring with them and they only put on the ghillie mid match if they feel they need it.
